assumptions: customer_id and SOLDTOPARTY may be join-compatible but must be tested
communications are event evidence, not labelled churn outcomes
equal-duration windows will be chosen from observed data coverage
objective: Identify customers that simultaneously show declining order activity and increasing complaint, delay, or payment-reminder communications, and produce an explainable descriptive watchlist rather than a churn prediction.
strategy: Use customer-linked ERP and communication sources; count distinct sales documents to avoid line-item fanout; compare equal chronological windows; classify adverse communications with transparent metadata and text rules; combine the two directional conditions; report coverage, sensitivity, and non-causal limitations.
